title: Gizemli Hikaye Küpleri: Uzay Macerası
author: Fatih Cem Gülbent
description: Are you ready to journey into the depths of space with mysterious story cubes? When Deniz uses the special cubes in his hand, a whole new adventure begins in his room, and an ordinary day turns into an unforgettable journey. This time, traveling among the stars, Deniz must solve the secrets of the Ice Planet. Accompanying him is Tavşik, the first rabbit-naut! Join the excitement, steer the spaceship, escape the ice crystals, and try to reach the mysterious box. Remember, every choice will take you on a different adventure! What's more, even when the story ends, the fun continues! Cut out the templates on the back page, fold and glue them together to create your own story cubes.
english_title: Mysterious Story Cubes: Journey to Space
